title: Business Platinum Rewards Card: Understanding Your Annual Fee and Premium Perks
summary: This document explains the Business Platinum Rewards Card annual fee ($450 standard, $0 first-year promotional) and how it’s billed and auto-renewed. It also details premium perks: unlimited airport lounge visits, $400 annual travel credits, travel insurance up to $62,500 per trip, purchase protection up to $17,500 per claim, and 0% foreign transaction fee.
